audience: IT and facilities teams that track assets, licenses and check-outs in Snipe-IT

useCases.title: Find an asset and its current holder
useCases.text: Find an asset by its asset tag or serial number, then read its status, assignment and checkout history.

useCases.title: List what one person holds
useCases.text: Find a user, then list the assets currently checked out to that user.

useCases.title: Find licenses that are almost out of seats
useCases.text: List software licenses with their seat counts, then read who holds each seat of one license.

useCases.title: Check an asset out or back in
useCases.text: Check an asset out to a user, asset or location, or check it back in with a status label.

useCases.title: Find assets with overdue audits
useCases.text: List the assets whose physical audit is overdue.
